date: "`r Sys.Date()`"

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
yog_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(YTQYOGYR != 0) |> 
  select(YTQYOGYR)

p_yoga <- ggplot(yog_df, aes(factor(YTQYOGYR, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#E5A2FA", color= "#674A70", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to YTQYOGYR", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to YTQYOGYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you practice yoga?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
yog_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(YTQYOGPAIN != 0) |> 
  select(YTQYOGPAIN)

p_yoga_pain <- ggplot(yog_pain_df, aes(factor(YTQYOGPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#BD9FFC", color = "#574973", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to YTQYOGPAIN", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to YTQYOGPAIN", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "In the past 12 months have you used yoga for pain? "
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

p_yoga + p_yoga_pain
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
yog_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$YTQYOGYR, 2)
yog_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$YTQYOGYR, 1)

yog_yes # n = 4291
yog_no # n = 22264

yog_yes_per <- round((yog_yes/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)
yog_no_per <- round((yog_no/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)
# 15.518 % of adults in our sample have answered 'yes' to having practiced 
# yoga in the past 12 months 
```
YTQYOGYR: *Have you practiced yoga in the past 12 months?*\
Yes: `r yog_yes`, (`r yog_yes_per`%)\
No: `r yog_no`, (`r yog_no_per`%)\

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

yog_pain_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$YTQYOGPAIN, 2)
yog_pain_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$YTQYOGPAIN, 1)

yog_pain_yes # n = 1290
yog_pain_no # n = 3000

yog_pain_yes_per <- round((yog_pain_yes/yog_yes)*100, 2)
yog_pain_no_per <- round((yog_pain_no/yog_yes)*100, 2)
# 30.1% of the 4291 people who answered yes to practicing yoga in the past year, 
# reported practicing yoga for pain management. 
```
YTQYOGPAIN: *"In the past 12 months have you used yoga for pain?"*\
Yes: `r yog_pain_yes`, (`r yog_pain_yes_per`%)\
No: `r yog_pain_no`, (`r yog_pain_no_per`%)\
